title: Pope wraps up Africa trip with diplomatic challenge in Equatorial Guinea
summary: Pope Leo XIV arrives in Equatorial Guinea on Tuesday in the final stop on his four-nation visit to Africa during which he has repeatedly called for an end to corruption.
